target.title: Fix the Content-Range end value
target.description: range_for_length already returns the last byte position, so subtracting one again under-reports the range in the Content-Range header.

Title: Fix the Content-Range end value

Description:
range_for_length already returns the last byte position, so subtracting one again under-reports the range in the Content-Range header.

arguments.summary: The pull request correctly fixes the Content-Range header generation by removing the redundant -1 subtraction on range[1], aligning with the fact that range_for_length already returns an exclusive upper bound stop position (or min(end, length)).
